purpose: Machine-readable register of everything the cleanliness gates (pipeline/gates.py) need: declared panel, protocol events, exclusions, statistics plan, results artefacts. Prose in docs/ is a reminder; this file is what the gates read.

condition_definitions.B: A plus 5 marker caveat windows, 40 words, same article
condition_definitions.C: A plus 5 caveat windows drawn from a random OTHER article

batching.rule: identical batching across all conditions and judges; one independent verdict per claim

exclusions.reason: misbar.com JS-rendered Wayback captures with no static text; declared before any judge run

protocol_events.summary: Judge inference through OpenCode subagent sessions instead of the OpenRouter API; claims batched 20 per session; identical batching across conditions and judges.
Judge panel fixed to the OpenCode Go pool, one model per family: claude-haiku-5-5, gemini-4-argon, gpt-6-luna, deepseek-v4-pro.

protocol_events.reason: Three provider content-filter blocks ('Provider blocked the response'), including one attempt with a no-profanity-quote instruction.
protocol_events.handling: All DeepSeek comparisons involving condition A are reported both with this batch (mixed-model cell, labelled) and without it (176 claims, single model). The excluded-batch result is primary if the two disagree.

statistics_plan.primary_metric: exact-match accuracy of the 4-way verdict against the AVeriTeC label, per (judge, condition)
statistics_plan.mde_note: exact McNemar on n=196 paired claims needs >=7 net discordant pairs to survive Holm across the two mandatory comparisons, i.e. about 3.6 percentage points

quote_provenance.note: A quote must appear verbatim (case/quote-normalised) in the excerpts shown with that claim in that condition. Contamination (absent from its own condition, present in another condition's text for the same claim) fails hard at any count: it would mean a session saw another condition's context. Paraphrasing is a data-quality defect, not contamination: the global rate must clear min_global_match_rate, and any judge below min_judge_match_rate is reported as a WARN and must be disclosed in the paper.

ledger.note: Cells produced before required_from_utc are audited structurally only; the orchestrator log was not retained as a machine artefact, so their session ids are marked not-retained rather than invented.
